name: Half Cover
description: A creature has half cover when an obstacle blocks at least half of its body — low walls, large furniture, narrow tree trunks, or another creature. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws.

name: Three-Quarters Cover
description: A creature has three-quarters cover when about three-quarters of its body is covered — a portcullis, an arrow slit, a thick tree trunk. The target gains a +5 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws.

name: Total Cover
description: A creature with total cover can't be targeted directly by an attack or spell — it must be entirely hidden behind an obstacle. Some attacks can still affect it through area effects.
